approval: Standing approval for helpers composed from already resolved component correspondences. Every approved exact processing profile has only active technosphere inputs, no direct biosphere or unsupported exchange types, and a unit-magnitude self-linked production reference. Exact provider/profile factors retain processing burdens and genuine recovered-product credits separately. Existing component proxies remain approximations; no missing, omitted or empty component is silently substituted. No new process primitive or mathematical inverse is inferred. Production-only cut-off stock dependencies require an explicitly approved direct supplier, exact source profile and review fingerprint. Every other observed counterpart is enumerated as pending and remains blocked; partial approvals never resolve a whole identity.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed processing-inventory composition: retain all inspected active technosphere inputs through the already resolved directional component correspondences for this exact profile. The source has one unit-magnitude self-linked production reference, no active direct biosphere exchanges and no unsupported exchange types. Retain processing inputs, freight and genuine recovered-product credits; apply each provider's reference-sign factor independently, distinguishing treatment demand from negative product credits. No component omission, empty allocation, new technology primitive or missing-provider fallback is used. The inherited component correspondences approximate technology, material composition, geography and allocation; resolved signs do not establish scientific or LCIA equivalence. Internal component uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller-owned signed quantities, supported uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions, including full original-exchange change records. Net impacts may legitimately be negative where recovery credits exceed processing burdens. Score and export all returned helpers. Only enumerated exact profiles are approved; no reverse mapping is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Reviewed source-function boundary repairs are applied only to source-witnessed child suppliers. All other inventory inputs, freight choices and emissions are retained; see brightpath/data/export/uvek_cable_rail_review.json.

The source has one unit-magnitude self-linked production reference, no active direct biosphere exchanges and no unsupported exchange types. rules.review_rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Reviewed source-function boundary repairs are applied only to source-witnessed child suppliers. All other inventory inputs, freight choices and emissions are retained; see brightpath/data/export/uvek_cable_rail_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Follow-up older regional road correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for original all-sizes road markets. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred. Reviewed source-function boundary repairs are applied only to source-witnessed child suppliers. All other inventory inputs, freight choices and emissions are retained; see brightpath/data/export/uvek_cable_rail_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Follow-up older regional road correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for original all-sizes road markets. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred. Reviewed source-function boundary repairs are applied only to source-witnessed child suppliers. All other inventory inputs, freight choices and emissions are retained; see brightpath/data/export/uvek_cable_rail_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Follow-up regional freight correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for unspecified diesel road markets; original Swiss electric/diesel rail shares through complete CH rail services. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. In the explicitly inspected cut-off profiles, the copper Recycled Content stock contains only self-production+1. Preserve its original signed kg through the approved allocated stock helper, with an explicit warning; do not import PV-panel takeback/recycling burdens or an avoided-production credit. Keep every other original processing input, transport quantity, separate emission and independently reviewed recovery credit unchanged. Historical consequential quantities are unchanged and no executable consequential route is approved.

No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. In the explicitly inspected cut-off profiles, the copper Recycled Content stock contains only self-production+1. Preserve its original signed kg through the approved allocated stock helper, with an explicit warning; do not import PV-panel takeback/recycling burdens or an avoided-production credit. Keep every other original processing input, transport quantity, separate emission and independently reviewed recovery credit unchanged. Historical consequential quantities are unchanged and no executable consequential route is approved.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed processing-inventory composition: retain all inspected active technosphere inputs through the already resolved directional component correspondences for this exact profile. The source has one unit-magnitude self-linked production reference, no active direct biosphere exchanges and no unsupported exchange types. Retain processing inputs, freight and genuine recovered-product credits; apply each provider's reference-sign factor independently, distinguishing treatment demand from negative product credits. No component omission, empty allocation, new technology primitive or missing-provider fallback is used. The inherited component correspondences approximate technology, material composition, geography and allocation; resolved signs do not establish scientific or LCIA equivalence. Internal component uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller-owned signed quantities, supported uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions, including full original-exchange change records. Net impacts may legitimately be negative where recovery credits exceed processing burdens. Score and export all returned helpers. Only enumerated exact profiles are approved; no reverse mapping is inferred. Follow-up regional freight correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for unspecified diesel road markets; original Swiss electric/diesel rail shares through complete CH rail services. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred.

rules.review_rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. In the explicitly inspected cut-off profiles, the copper Recycled Content stock contains only self-production+1. Preserve its original signed kg through the approved allocated stock helper, with an explicit warning; do not import PV-panel takeback/recycling burdens or an avoided-production credit. Keep every other original processing input, transport quantity, separate emission and independently reviewed recovery credit unchanged. Historical consequential quantities are unchanged and no executable consequential route is approved.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json. Follow-up older regional road correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for original all-sizes road markets. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred. Reviewed source-function boundary repairs are applied only to source-witnessed child suppliers. All other inventory inputs, freight choices and emissions are retained; see brightpath/data/export/uvek_cable_rail_review.json.

re_review_batches.limitations: Independently inspected ecoinvent 3.6 sawing-slurry treatment composition per litre received: retain all electricity, the source silicone-factory infrastructure proxy and waste-treatment demands through their existing directional correspondences. Both regional processes have a self-linked -1 litre reference and no active direct biosphere or unsupported exchanges. Consequential profiles additionally retain the original negative silicon-carbide and triethylene-glycol product credits; the receiving commodity markets and UVEK production primitives have positive kg references. Do not take an absolute value, convert litres to kg, insert recovery credits into cut-off treatment or infer equal moisture, yields or LCIA scores. The source itself uses silicone-factory infrastructure; source and target construction descriptions identify the same chemical-plant proxy, not a newly invented silicon plant. Inherited electricity supply mixes, RoW-to-Swiss electricity proxy, plant geography, primary-product supply replacing consequential displaced markets, waste composition, treatment routes, upstream allocation, emissions and transport remain approximations. Internal uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signs, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions. Include all returned helpers in scoring and exports. Only four observed 3.6 profiles are approved; newer sludge recovery/co-processing/landfill routes and unknown patches remain pending. No reverse correspondence is inferred.
